scope: Shipping guest JavaScript executed in existing Node VM fixtures with controlled UA device selection, tracks, promises, audio objects and signaling. No actual browser, RTC, media/device capture, native app, audio output or network run.
finding: Rechecking previously selected camera and microphone omitted deviceId constraints, allowing a UA-valid different default to replace current tracks. Failed switches could also leave a selector displaying uncommitted hardware.
behavior: Page-memory per-kind choices commit only with a successful current capture transaction. Rechecks request exact committed IDs. Missing/revoked choices preserve healthy old tracks, current peer and invite without unconstrained fallback; deliberate successful replacement updates only its kind. Enumeration retains an unavailable selected option. Failed/superseded requests do not commit choice intent.
newCases: Explicit chosen camera and microphone survive recheck even when unconstrained UA defaults differ; mute, peer and invite retained
Missing exact camera refuses default fallback, preserves healthy microphone/peer/invite, and deliberate replacement recovers
Permission refusal retains chosen devices and healthy tracks for next recheck
Failed sender replacement does not commit choice or misleading selector
Late superseded selection cannot overwrite the latest committed choice
Enumeration keeps unavailable committed choice visible rather than selecting another source
counterfactual: The exact base shipping source and fixed source run the same current test fixture. The controlled UA resolves exact IDs or rejects an unavailable exact ID, while unconstrained requests choose a different valid default. All six new assertions fail against base source; existing17 remain passing.
checks: Pinned Node syntax check for changed production and fixture JS passed
